notes: Build72 adds Portable Skills v2 as the local-first Skills authority. SKILL.md packages use YAML frontmatter plus Markdown with optional references, assets and trust-controlled scripts. The registry validates canonical paths, package/file byte budgets, sensitive-file exclusions and GitHub HTTPS origins; package content receives a SHA-256 content hash plus provenance/source revision metadata. Skill permissions are advisory constraints only: writeAuthority=false, canExpandScope=false and any write/script request still requires Decrypter approval. Scripts are never staged unless explicitly requested and allowed only for builtin/verified trust with separate approval. Per-run staging copies are immutable, bounded by Context Engine-compatible budgets and never mutate source Skills. Existing ld-skills and ld-custom-skills remain optional synchronization sources, while Auto Skill selection is portable-local-v2 and no longer requires Gemini/cloud routing. Public GitHub Skill import uses api.github.com with strict owner/repo/path/size validation and blocks non-GitHub/private-network source URLs. Build71 Universal Agent Runtime Registry remains proposal-only with session-only credentials; Build70 Account Integration Gate remains mandatory. Cumulative guarantees remain explicit: Build65 Scope Intelligence v2 + Human Intent with USER_EDIT > AI_EDIT; Build66 Smart Undo/Redo with three-way preservation and one-shot confirmations; Build67 Continuity Engine; Build68 Local Agent Orchestrator + Model Router with exact proposal digest binding and zero paid/remote fallback; Build69 DecrypterBench v2 / Hardening with path traversal defenses; Context Engine v2; MCP 2026-07-28 Trust Gateway; Guarded Commit.
